title: The fake-install-root fixture has six homes and converging two of them would read as done
body:
**FOUR test files build a fake install root; two extracted a helper and did it differently, two build it inline.** `intent-cli/tests/{an_absent_rule_library_is_visible_at_the_process_surface,claude_cwi_door}.rs` and `intentsvcs/tests/{skills_sync,subagents_payload}.rs`.

**THIS READ SIX UNTIL cc CORRECTED IT (2026-09-08). The figure is struck rather than annotated, because a count left standing beside its correction is the thing the next reader greps.** ic selected on the STRING `lib/templates`; cc narrowed to the OPERATION, `create_dir_all(<x>.join("lib/templates"))`, and two of the six do not survive it. `bootstrap_door.rs:80` is an `assert!` that a recorded pointer names a REAL install; `exit_code_consumers.rs:217` is a `canon_root()` walking up from `workspace_root()` to the real SHIPPED `lib/templates`. **Neither creates anything.** cc controlled the discriminator both ways before using it -- 0 on the agreed non-member, 1 on a member they had edited -- and checked neither file builds an install by another route.

The two extracted shapes are not rivals: `fixture_install(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf` has the caller own the tempdir; `fixture_install() -> TempDir` creates it and additionally seeds `intent/plugins/claude/bin` with a copied launcher. **C is A plus a plugin step.** The honest convergence is a base that builds marker + copied binary and returns the dir, with plugin seeding as a separate call.

**THE CONDITION ON DOING IT, AND IT IS THE WHOLE REASON THIS IS FILED RATHER THAN DONE: ALL FOUR OR NONE** (it read ALL SIX; the principle is untouched by the recount). Converging the extracted pair while the inline sites remain takes the count from four to three and **makes the finding read as done**, which removes the pressure to finish it. ic's phrasing: *that is the cosmetic half of the job*. A partial convergence is worse than none, because none stays visible.

**THREE NON-MEMBERS, AND THEY ARE ONE CLASS RATHER THAN THREE MISTAKES: `critic_surface.rs`, `bootstrap_door.rs`, `exit_code_consumers.rs`. EVERY ONE OF THEM HAS THE REAL TREE AS ITS SUBJECT.**

**THE INSTRUCTIVE PART IS THAT ic CORRECTED THE INSTANCE AND NOT THE CLASS.** `critic_surface.rs` was found by reading its body and struck; the body-read was never re-applied to the rest of the same list, so two files of identical shape stood in it unexamined -- **an instance-shaped correction to a class-shaped defect, published in a filing whose author had spent the day telling other nodes to sweep the class and name the paths.** cc found them by narrowing the criterion rather than by re-reading the list, which is the more reliable route: **ic's criterion selected on a string that appears in a CONSTRUCTION and in an ASSERTION alike, so no amount of care applied to it could have separated them.**

**AND ic MIS-STATED THE CRITERION'S WEAKNESS IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION.** It was published as a proxy that might MISS a builder. cc showed it cannot: `intentsvcs/src/install.rs:51` declares `pub const MARKER: &str = "lib/templates"` and `is_install` is exactly `dir.join(MARKER).is_dir()`, so a directory without the marker is not an install root by the authority of the code that resolves one. **The criterion could not under-count; it over-counted**, and cc also swept the constant form (`join(install::MARKER)`) in case a literal grep missed it. Nothing.

**ON `critic_surface.rs` SPECIFICALLY:** it builds no fake install at all. It uses `repo_root()`, a `fixture(name)` pointing at the REAL shipped rule library, and drives `CARGO_BIN_EXE_intent` from the repo root -- **its subject IS the real tree, deliberately.** It was carried on the strength of having a function called `fixture`. **Classified by the name of a function rather than by what the function does**, which is the third instance this week of a name asserting a behaviour nobody checked the body for.

**SEPARATE AND SHARPER, RULED AND BEING DONE NOW, NOT PART OF THIS ISSUE:** three files re-implemented `fn repo_root()` as `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/../../../..` while the rest used `testkit::repo_root`. **DONE at `36f327dd`; the true user count is 39, reconciled to the file after ic and vc published 37 and 38 and were each under on a different axis -- a one-level `tests/*.rs` glob misses `src/tui/mode.rs` and `tests/common/mod.rs`, and a bare `testkit::repo_root` pattern cannot match the GROUPED import in testkit's own test of the function.** That is a real divergence with a failure mode -- testkit asserts `schema/` and `surface/` are both directories and fails loudly by name; path arithmetic returns a directory that exists whatever it points at, so a wrong root is silent and every test then runs against it. **`testkit/src/lib.rs:70-72` already makes this argument in its own doc comment**, for the workspace root, in the canonical home the three copies bypass.
